title: Mixed Event — On This Holy Night, I Sing — Episode5 The Show Back Then

meta.Event: On This Holy Night, I Sing
meta.Event Outline: For their second show for the Show Contest, Tsukasa and the rest of WxS are preparing a Christmas-themed musical! However, a prima donna with a voice powerful enough to shock even Nene stands in their path...! Curtains open for these two songstresses as they each put their pride on the line!

rows.Line: One week later
Wonder Stage

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: There's one house left on my list. Let's go!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Okay, but... Hey, wait for me!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Great. That scene is perfect.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: We only have one week left until we open, so we should start doing full rehearsals.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Excellent! We've finally made it this far!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
But, Rui...  What about Nene?
She still seems anxious about singing...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Well, it's her emotional state that's the problem, as opposed to anything technical. The best we can do is give her the time she needs to work it out herself.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: For now, we should carry on with rehearsals...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Once we have everything else nailed down, Nene will be able to focus on improving her singing.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: But it doesn't feel right to just leave her all by herself! Isn't there anything we can do...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
How did you sing before what happened?
That might give you a clue as to what to...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: She needs to remember as much as she can about her past self, right?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hey, Neneee!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Wah...! Wh-What is it?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Nene, I wanna get to know you better!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Know me? Like how?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: You were a member of a theater troupe before, right? What kinds of shows did you guys do? Which ones did you like? And...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: S-Slow down! Don't ask me so many questions at once or I won't know where to start...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Besides, we shouldn't be wasting time chatting. We don't have much time left, so we can come back to this later.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Nooo! Wait! I want to talk NOW! Pleeease! I'll trade you a taiyaki for your stories!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Uh, I'm not that big on taiyaki...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Why don't we take a break now?
That way you'll have time to chat.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: You might even enjoy opening up a bit and sharing your memories with a friend.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Sigh...
Fine, but only until the break's over.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yay!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I have so many questions! For starters... When did you realize you wanted to do theater?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: When I was in elementary school...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: We moved next door to Rui, and our parents became friends. One day, we all went to see a play together.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: It was really incredible.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I felt as if I was in a dream. When the play ended, I just sat there for a while with my head in the clouds.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: That's when I knew this is what I wanted to do.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (And yet...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(I can't remember my next line!
What should I do? What should I do!)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I ruined that show...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: The show was like a dream?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah! I totally get it!!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I had the exact same experience!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Grandpa took me to a play when I was little and it was like a really amazing dream!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I was sitting right here.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh? This seat...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yup! The middle seat at the front was always reserved for me!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I can picture you as a little girl, sitting on this bench, watching a show...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah! And now you're sitting next to me. It's all spooky, like the past and present is coming together!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Hehe, yeah.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: And you know, after seeing that play, I saw it again in my dreams that night!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
I've had that happen to me too.
In my dreams, it was me on stage.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah, same! But after dancing lots and lots...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: You wake up in the morning and realize you've fallen out of bed, right?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Um, no. I can't relate to that one...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: How do you sleep through that...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: It's funny how you two also got into acting thanks to your family taking you to see a memorable play.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I also saw my first play with my family. My sister's health wasn't that great back then, but that day she felt well enough to go out. She was so happy.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: She loved the play so much, I decided to become an actor so that I could cheer her up like that too.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh, I see...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Ever since then, I've been training to be an actor by learning to sing, dance and strike awesome poses!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. Nene and I also immediately started working on our own little shows.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Rui's always been full of crazy ideas. He wanted me to jump into the river once, told me to learn to juggle with my feet and...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Oh? I did?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Hey, don't pretend like you don't remember.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehe♪ I wish I could see the shows you did when you were little☆

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Well, you can see mine whenever you want!
My parents recorded all of them!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Really?! You have to show me♪

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Little Tsukasa's first ventures into theater... I'm sure there are some... Real gems in those videos.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: No need to go so overboard with the sarcasm.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (What was I like back then?)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (After discovering theater, I forgot all about playing games or reading manga. All I did was sing...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I'd sing all day long and annoy mom...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (But I was having so much fun...)
